This one I don't like as much. Clicking the title swallowed my whole library and dropped the page in its place, so now I've lost my spot — if I'd been halfway down a list or in the middle of a search, I'd have to find my way back and set it all up again just to open the next thing. When I'm going through my bookmarks I'm usually opening a few in a row, so that back-and-forth would get tiresome fast.

So I'll stick with the first version — opening the page in a new tab and keeping my library sitting there. That's the one that fits how I actually browse. Let's go with new-tab.
